tests.title: parses named and positional plain decimals and refuses every other form with exact messages
negotiates pinned dblp for every input format, reproduces native neighbours and declares its capabilities
has no format constraint: every rate, channel count and container layout name passes validation
plans unchanged counts and packets and reserves one frame plus three doubles per channel
matches a direct transcription of the C loop bit for bit and is invariant to frame splits
runs through the chain from packed integer input, leaves inputs untouched and owns its output planes
enforces allocation, channel, finiteness and cancellation limits
matches native framecrc bytes for every sensitivity and base frequency on all sources, 1-3 channels and f64/f32/s16 outputs
matches native across composed chains, asetnsamples splits, defaults, positional options and output time selection
writes native-identical WAV, AIFF and raw PCM files from WAV and raw inputs
fails explicitly before output for native errors, unimplemented option forms, timeline enable and rate conversion

details: 540 framecrc: sensitivity {0,2,1000} x basefreq {2,1000,22050,1000000} x u8/s16/s32/f32/f64 input x 1-3 channels x pcm_f64le/pcm_f32le/pcm_s16le output, -cpuflags 0, 44100 Hz, multi-frame input

672 framecrc: 14 composed chains (asetnsamples splits, volume, aformat, apad, adelay, defaults, positional/named options) x s16/f64 input x 1-2 channels x 6 output selections (-ss, -t, -ss+-t, -to, -frames:a) x 2 encoders
9 framecrc: 8000/22050/48000 Hz with input -ss/-t; 2 framecrc on empty input
30 files: WAV/AIFF/raw output from raw and WAV input in all five formats
14 refusals with native exit status asserted (8 native-rejected, 5 native-accepted unimplemented forms, -ar 16000 rate conversion); no output written

unsupported: option values other than plain decimals (exponents, signs, hex, SI suffixes, expressions)
automatic sample-rate conversion after the filter
bit-exactness on natives that fuse multiply-adds (e.g. macOS arm64); differential byte tests are gated to linux/x64

notes: No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed.
Setup durations: submodule init 48s; npm ci + reference:build 3m23s; baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 1m05s; baseline unit suite 1m32s; differential suite 23s.
Baseline failures are the expected FLAC artifact tests (downloads.xiph.org blocked) and resample-checkpoint macOS golden digests.
The upstream file has no individual copyright line; NOTICE-ADYNAMICSMOOTH says so.
Positional values follow native option order (sensitivity, basefreq).
